literal: They who love, by those they love to be loved having obtained, have obtained indeed, love's seedless fruit.
translation: Those who are loved in return by the very ones they love have truly obtained the seedless, sweet fruit of love.
modern: தாங்கள் விரும்புகின்ற காதலரால் தங்களையும் விரும்பப் பெற்றவர்கள், காமத்தின் விதையற்ற இனிமையான கனியைப் பெற்றவர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the rare joy of mutual love. The speaker explains that when a person is loved back by the one they desire, they experience the ultimate fulfillment of love. This perfect union is compared to a seedless fruit (காழில் கனி). In a fruit, the hard seed or stone (காழ்) represents bitterness, pain, or difficulty, so a seedless fruit represents pure, uninterrupted sweetness and pleasure without any distress.
